title: config_desired
description: Hub to agent (request), feature config_sync (PLAN.md S20, D-027). The signed desired state: generation, policy and the item list. The signature covers the canonical JSON of {agent_id, generation, policy, items}; the agent id is not in the frame because it is the agent's own id. The result data has the shape config_desired_result_data in defs.schema.json.

items.description: The documents of the effective configuration, sorted by kind and id (ordinal order). The order is part of the signature.
